description: The line plot illustrates the average repetition rate across various relation categories for different methods used in relation extraction, with the x-axis representing the relation category (ranging from 0 to 65) and the y-axis showing the average repetition rate (ranging from 0.0 to 0.6). The plot includes five distinct lines: a solid blue line representing the method "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint," a solid orange line for "DPO," a solid green line for "Average of w/o DPO obo," a dashed orange line for "Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint," and a dashed green line for "Average of DPO." The blue line exhibits significant fluctuations, peaking sharply at approximately 0.6 at relation category 0 and showing other notable peaks around categories 23 and 32. The orange line also shows considerable variation, with peaks around categories 32 and 45. The green line remains relatively stable, hovering around 0.117, which is explicitly labeled on the plot. The dashed lines, representing averages, are relatively flat, with the dashed orange line at approximately 0.227 and the dashed green line at approximately 0.163, both of which are also labeled. The plot demonstrates that the "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint" method has the highest variability and peak repetition rates, while the "DPO" method and its average show more consistent and lower repetition rates.
